title: A Great Day in Koln
body: Had an absolute blast of a day hurling with the lads from Köln, München, Aachen, and Düsseldorf!
Brilliant to get everyone together for a day of football, craic, and a few well-earned drinks afterwards. A huge thanks to everyone who travelled over and helped make it such a great day.

title: Family Day in Waldau
body: We had a fantastic Family Day at Stuttgart GAA, with around 15 kids joining us for an afternoon of games, fun and plenty of running around!
There was plenty of time for the kids to enjoy themselves while parents and club members relaxed, caught up, and enjoyed some well-earned BBQ snacks and drinks.

A big thanks to everyone who came along and helped make the day such a great success. It was brilliant to see so many younger players getting involved — and we're already looking forward to the next one!

title: Berlin Tournament Success
body: We joined up with Vienna Gales GAA for a fantastic weekend of football in Berlin.
After a great day of competition, the Men’s team came away as Shield winners!
Most importantly, fair play to all our players who battled through some seriously difficult conditions,and showed great resilience, teamwork and spirit throughout the day.
